interactives.label: Rules of the stair
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the mine mouth. The waystones count you out. The court at the top is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The miners' stair
interactives.text: Two hundred steps were cut into the ice so the silver could come down in winter. The silver still comes down. The miners do not.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Ice Stair
gauntlet.flavour: A miners' stair up the inside of the glacier, cut for the silver and abandoned to what lives in the ice.
